subtitle: Foundational projects in industrial automation and control systems

description.summary: Design of an automated hydraulic press system including coordinated multi-cylinder sequencing and control logic.
description.context: Automation of a hydraulic press process involving positioning, pressing, translation, and part ejection using multiple actuators.
description.challenge: Coordinating a complete operation cycle across several cylinders (A, B, C, D) while ensuring correct sequencing, safe transitions, and repeatable operation.
description.solution: Designed hydraulic and electrical systems and implemented sequential control logic using relay-based automation, defining the full operation cycle (A+ B+ B- A- C+ D+ D- C-) and ensuring proper synchronization between actuators.

description.summary: Design and control of an electropneumatic system for container filling, sealing, and stamping operations.
description.context: Automated process involving filling, closing, and stamping of containers using pneumatic actuators, sensors, and timed sequences.
description.challenge: Coordinating multiple actuators (A, B, C, D), sensor inputs, and timing constraints to ensure correct sequencing of filling, sealing, and stamping operations.
description.solution: Designed the electropneumatic system and implemented control logic using both relay-based automation and PLC programming, integrating sensors, timers, and actuator control to manage the full operation cycle.

description.summary: Design of a SCADA system for monitoring and controlling a multi-pump installation with alarms and historical data.
description.context: Supervision and control of a three-pump system including automatic and manual operation modes, fault handling, and safety conditions.
description.challenge: Managing different operation modes (auto/manual), integrating fault detection, and ensuring reliable monitoring with alarms and historical tracking.
description.solution: Developed PLC control logic (Siemens S7-300) and implemented a WinCC SCADA interface with alarm management, historical data logging, and operator control for system supervision.

description.summary: Design of an industrial robotic palletizing system for sorting and stacking two product types based on color.
description.context: Automation of a palletizing process where products arriving on a conveyor had to be identified, picked by a robot, and placed on the correct pallet according to type.
description.challenge: Coordinating product detection, robot handling, pallet status control, and process continuity while preventing unloading onto full pallets.
description.solution: Developed the control logic for robotic palletizing, managing product classification, pallet assignment, full-pallet detection, and operator reset conditions after pallet replacement.
